description: This file implements the AWCContainerBase class methods, providing memory, processor, and network interface information for a process container in the Thunder project.

classes.name: AWCMemoryInfo
classes.description: A reference-counted implementation of IMemoryInfo providing memory usage details.

classes.name: AWCProcessorInfo
classes.description: A reference-counted implementation of IProcessorInfo providing CPU usage details.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns a new AWCMemoryInfo object representing memory info.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns a new AWCProcessorInfo object representing processor info.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns nullptr indicating no network interfaces are available or implemented.
